name: Peralada (Spain)
description: Red field with three yellow pales, each charged with three blue heraldic rocks.
history: The official flag of Peralada is an oblong flag of 2:3, a red field charged with three yellow pales each charged with three blue heraldic rocks; it is a heraldic flag of the arms of the Rocabertí family, marquesses of Peralada.

features.role: three heraldic rocks (chess rooks) on each pale, the arms of the Rocabertí
